summary: Thin camera/game-state wrapper that targets the currently tracked vehicle. Reads the tracked-vehicle index global dword_7C54E4, indexes the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 with it, reads the value at byte offset 18580 of that vehicle, and dispatches a game-state change targeting it through GameStateDispatchChain.

operations.description: Read the tracked-vehicle index global dword_7C54E4, index the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 with it, and read the int value at byte offset 18580 of the tracked vehicle (the finish-position value consumed by the dispatch).
Dispatch the game-state change targeting the tracked vehicle through GameStateDispatchChain(this, vehicle value).

unresolved: The exact meaning of the value at vehicle byte offset 18580 is inferred as a finish position from the parallel camera-target function using the same offset; its field name is unknown.
The meaning of the tracked-vehicle index global dword_7C54E4 (distinct from the player index dword_7C54DC used by the race-leader camera target) is unknown.
Identity and purpose of the this object (no fields recovered) are unknown.
Whether the game-state dispatch targets a vehicle, a team, or a derived entity is decided inside GameStateDispatchChain and is unresolved here.
